index.value: MSCI World ex Australia Quality Index
index.note: Quality-tilted subset (~300 stocks) of the MSCI World ex Australia Index, picked on return on equity, earnings stability and low debt; rebalanced each May and November. Not currency hedged (QHAL is the hedged version).

mer.note: Management fee 0.40%; indirect costs 0.00%; transaction costs 0.01% p.a. (FY to 30 Jun 2026)

yield.note: VanEck's 12-month fund dividend yield as at 30 Sep 2026 (prior 12 months' dividends / closing NAV at period end). Its 12-month income return is 3.64%. The underlying shares' own dividend yield is only 1.15% (fact sheet), so most of the payout is not from company dividends.

franking.note: VanEck shows the franking level as '--'; international shares carry no franking credits

listed.note: First day of trading on the ASX (ASX company listing date). Daily prices start here.

inception.note: Fund inception (seeded before quotation); listed on the ASX 31 Oct 2014

distributions.note: VanEck: '1 each year'; period ends 30 June, ex-date about 1 July, paid late July
